authorization: User authorizes A_CI scoped adjudication after final independent CI3 PASS and CI0-CI3 paired scientific completion.

claims.statement: CI ordinary-step sequencing and full fresh poststate J/H root identity; stage observations, not native autonomous topology execution.
The reviewed full-feedback paired CI anchor uses evolving W and a fresh joint root to select fission, with unsplit/history-reset obstruction, independent target-role admission and actual restoration.

The fixed-profile positive-parameter/request box has a uniform joint-root self-map, contraction and regularity theorem, evolving-W obstruction and both-role positive funding, transfer/entry/return/asymptotics, conditional on a resolved admitted source event.

The quadratic subclass has a full-graph research reference with independent Decimal joint-root comparisons, J/H covariance, both-role lifecycle/replay/atomicity and finite represented C/W/J/H errors; exact-boundary and execution-provenance corrections are reviewed, with charge drift retained.

debts.title: Source and execution-subject admission
debts.activation: Any assertion about current source authority or native Tranche-7/ATC execution.
debts.closure_requirement: Pin repository commits, source bytes, release, dependencies and exact results. Retrieved main pages and older local attachments cannot stand in for the final execution subject.
debts.earned_scope: Exact research inputs, ordinary CI staging, kernels and captures are pinned.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Native autonomous execution subject, release and integration remain downstream.

debts.title: Endogenous constitutive closure
debts.activation: A proposal claims that the event is generated by the permitted scientific state.
debts.closure_requirement: Name every causal input and choice; close guard, resolution, construction, identity and outcome rules; challenge administrative and hidden-state dependence.
debts.earned_scope: Fresh committed C/W and its full joint root determine the paired source-only guard, sectors, share and construction.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Only resolved admitted events; not universal or whole-box formation.

debts.title: Temporal stage and historical operand
debts.activation: A witness uses consumed current, threshold crossing, or a previous state rather than the declared present reconstruction.
debts.closure_requirement: Bind the exact stage and all required past preimages; show replay and reset semantics.
debts.earned_scope: CI-0/CI-3 distinguish consumed from fresh postbeat roots and preserve ordinary/event/reset/replay staging.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Other schedulers or historical guards require separate contracts.

debts.title: Analysis-to-constitutive consumption
debts.activation: A source analysis object becomes a physical event guard.
debts.closure_requirement: Admit the successor consumer, stage and complete-profile identity without relabeling a diagnostic as an existing actuator.
debts.earned_scope: The explicit CI consumer uses its own full joint root and complete research profile.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: No inherited native actuator authority or OS/PC substitution.

debts.title: Branch and regularity applicability
debts.activation: A claim uses a structural chart, current slaving derivative, or classical section derivative.
debts.closure_requirement: Supply the exact branch, association, domain and derivatives; retain RG2b Lipschitz alternatives and kink/rank boundaries.
debts.earned_scope: CI-2 proves uniform self-map, contraction, reference-connected branch and Schur-complement regularity on the radius-1/4096 joint-root neighborhood.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Other roots, larger domains, rank/kink changes and RG2b alternatives are not classified.

debts.title: Functional, tangent, metric and normalization
debts.activation: A claim invokes structural alpha, joint-state energy or magnitude comparisons.
debts.closure_requirement: Instantiate the complete functional and constrained domain; distinguish fixed W from temporal W/Z variation; remove/classify nulls.
debts.earned_scope: Paired charge-constrained C/W domain, H neighborhood and resource/Frobenius norms are explicit; W evolves and geometry is reconstructed.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: No arbitrary structural energy, eigenmode normalization or viability-functional equivalence is claimed.

debts.title: Physical discrimination of a trigger
debts.activation: A numerical or structural witness is claimed to warrant an RC topology response.
debts.closure_requirement: Retain no-event and consumer-off controls; distinguish softening, numerical certification, history loss and actual graph-response effects.
debts.earned_scope: Unsplit and W-reset controls retain the obstruction; support-changing fission yields actual CI return.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Paired law/domain only; wider formation and active environments remain open.

debts.title: Mode-to-locus and half-edge lift
debts.activation: A mode or response is claimed to determine graph surgery.
debts.closure_requirement: Specify coordinate meaning, sign/degeneracy handling, loops, partition and covariance; compare competing lifts.
debts.earned_scope: Decorated paired sectors and resolved root inflows determine 2+2 half-edge fission; joint J/H covariance is checked.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Arbitrary degrees, loops and alternative templates require separate maps and evidence.

debts.title: Within/across-family resolution order
debts.activation: A law compares candidates or operation families.
debts.closure_requirement: State units, score/order/exclusivity, margins and unresolved outcomes; do not infer cross-family comparability.
debts.earned_scope: One fission family does not activate cross-family scores or resolution order.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Within/across-family competition, ordering and exclusivity remain open.

debts.title: Finite-precision equivariance and threshold certainty
debts.activation: Exact covariance or stable physical decisions are claimed in a numerical implementation.
debts.closure_requirement: Use exact comparisons/enclosures or declared robust domains; challenge relabelings, orientations and threshold ties.
debts.earned_scope: Exact predicates, outward joint-root enclosures, sub-grid/tie pressure and represented pairing protect bounded admission.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Indefinite represented equivariance, numerical threshold coverage and production policy remain open.

debts.title: Batch and sequential critical pairs
debts.activation: Disjoint events or an atomic rewrite are claimed equivalent to sequential edits.
debts.closure_requirement: Prove combined reference/history/resource maps, intermediate admission, and required equality notions; account for global reset effects.
debts.earned_scope: One isolated event makes no overlapping-batch or critical-pair equivalence claim.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Batch commutation and sequential competition remain open.

debts.title: Complete finite graph/template mechanics
debts.activation: A template is claimed graph-generic or collision-free.
debts.closure_requirement: Close endpoint roles, loops, parallel edges, fresh IDs, boundary mappings and any finite template grammar.
debts.earned_scope: The exact paired source/double-star target, lineage and bridge mechanics are explicit.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: General templates, loops/parallel edges and fresh-ID runtime mechanics remain outside scope.

debts.title: Represented resource law and actual charge
debts.activation: Real coefficient conservation is promoted to an executable or exactly closed event.
debts.closure_requirement: Bind representable coefficients and rounding, validate both roles and actual charge; no silent residual correction.
debts.earned_scope: Both-role exact-real charge and finite publication rounding/error/charge drift are retained.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Exact stored conservation and production rounding remain open; no silent repair.

debts.title: Target reference, backend and context
debts.activation: A new graph is claimed to have a complete target package.
debts.closure_requirement: Construct every target coordinate, reference seed, structural base, backend, context and complete-profile identity under fixed domains.
debts.earned_scope: All target C/W coordinates, bridge seed, reference geometry and full root are reconstructed in the fixed CI domain/profile.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Other backends, contexts, graphs and profile changes require applicability evidence.

debts.title: History transport or explicitly declared loss
debts.activation: A topology map is claimed to preserve or transform W/Z history.
debts.closure_requirement: Supply separately typed channel maps and source/target lineage, or retain honest reconstruction/loss; never infer from shape or resource T.
debts.earned_scope: Old W follows exact edge lineage; only bridge W=1 is seeded. CI has no Z carrier.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Other history policies, persistent carriers and unrelated operations remain outside scope.

debts.title: Initializer and whole-role target integration
debts.activation: A constructed target is claimed fully admitted.
debts.closure_requirement: Use the accepted initializer order and independently reconstruct current/reset; preserve target numerical and atomic failures.
debts.earned_scope: Both actual roles are independently transported and full-root readmitted before publication; final/reset-only failures are preserved.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Bounded bridge seeding is not generic initializer or native integration authority.

debts.title: Core object and topology correspondence
debts.activation: An event is called an R_coh, basin, spark, or identity-topology event.
debts.closure_requirement: Map substrate state to the exact spatial/support/finite-continuation objects and demonstrate the requested change.
debts.earned_scope: Paired fission does not claim correspondence to core spatial/support/finite-continuation objects.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Core-object correspondence and its semantic claims remain open.

debts.title: Viability functional and threshold
debts.activation: A guard is identified with core viability or compared across graphs.
debts.closure_requirement: Bind functional/sign/normalization/anchor/units/locus and threshold or crossing; distinguish relative proposals from V=-P.
debts.earned_scope: No absolute/relative viability functional or threshold is selected.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Viability sign, normalization, units, locus and threshold require separate evidence.

debts.title: Restoration and actual dynamics
debts.activation: A target is claimed inside a stable basin or an attracting set.
debts.closure_requirement: Prove the specified basin/equilibrium/Lyapunov certificate for the actual relevant state and dynamics, with numerical-error and hybrid-loop scope.
debts.earned_scope: CI-2 proves actual evolving-W entry, contraction and asymptotics; CI-3 independently checks the research equations.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Active environments, wider graphs, repeated hybrid events and indefinite numerical continuation remain open.

debts.title: Finite persistence to identity/formation
debts.activation: Finite observation or graph structure is promoted to spark, identity, reflexive closure, or native formation.
debts.closure_requirement: Supply the additional core-specific basin, attraction, invariance, closure and provenance evidence.
debts.earned_scope: Paired return is not core identity, formation or organizational closure.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Additional core-specific identity/formation evidence remains open.

debts.title: Atomic composition and publication closure
debts.activation: An ATC wrapper is claimed to preserve lifecycle guarantees.
debts.closure_requirement: Define transaction boundaries and report composition; verify target and prospective archive before publication; preserve programmer-error semantics.
debts.earned_scope: Both-role readmission precedes research publication; replay/reset/injected failures verify whole-publication rollback and programmer-error propagation.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Native K0 scheduling and production transaction conformance are downstream.

debts.title: Causal memory, timing and event rate
debts.activation: Refractory counters, probes, crossings, repeated attempts, or non-Zeno claims are activated.
debts.closure_requirement: Declare causal history and lifecycle maps, eligible boundaries, work bounds and clock assumptions; distinguish finite beats from physical time.
debts.earned_scope: Variable ordinary requests and one event do not establish repeated-event or non-Zeno behavior.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Causal clocks, repeated attempts and physical-time event-rate work remain open.

debts.title: Native execution and reproducible evidence
debts.activation: The proposal claims actual GRCV4 execution, covariance, replay or rollback.
debts.closure_requirement: Run the admitted exact subject with independent expectations, retained failures and source-bound captures.
debts.earned_scope: Source-bound CI stages, reference/oracle, lifecycle and finite representation evidence are reproducible and reviewed.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Not native autonomous GRCV4 execution or public production conformance.

debts.title: Investigation and side-tool source admission
debts.activation: Local ATC records are to become queryable scientific authority.
debts.closure_requirement: Use the actual source-observation/classification/adapter/readmission/rebuild/audit/acceptance route; preserve reciprocal claim/debt lineage.
debts.earned_scope: The pinned CI adapter/ledger observes exact sources, readmits/rebuilds the append-only graph and exposes reciprocal typed claim/debt traces.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Only this exact inventory; future source additions require successor admission.

debts.title: Complete quotient or behavioral approximation
debts.activation: A merge is claimed to preserve or approximate complete behavior.
debts.closure_requirement: Supply H on every causal coordinate, domain invariance, exact or bounded intertwining, and target Lipschitz constants.
debts.earned_scope: Fission is not a behavioral quotient or approximate merge.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Complete coarsening/intertwining remains open.

debts.title: Complete-profile target applicability
debts.activation: A family-level formula is promoted to multi-profile support.
debts.closure_requirement: Record exact domains and targets for all ten products; preserve unsupported cells without weakening the realization.
debts.earned_scope: The paired A_CI profile box is covered under its premises; executable evidence covers the quadratic subclass.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Other realizations, all ten families and arbitrary parameters/graphs remain unsupported.

debts.title: Relation/coarsening semantic driver
debts.activation: Present coupling or inactivity is called missing relation, redundancy, death or extinction.
debts.closure_requirement: Demonstrate the operation-specific causal meaning; test zero-current bridges, hidden W/Z, existing nonedge mediation and delayed effects.
debts.earned_scope: No relation birth, pruning, redundancy, death or extinction semantics are asserted.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: Those operation-specific causal meanings remain open.

debts.title: Finite search/work and objective interpretation
debts.activation: A finite partition optimizer or template grammar is treated as scalable or core-derived.
debts.closure_requirement: Bind objective and search semantics, complexity/work budgets and exact outcome independence; distinguish computational failure from physical absence.
debts.earned_scope: Bounded paired prescription and root/share certification have finite work and fail-closed unresolved outcomes.
debts.remaining_or_reactivation: No scalable arbitrary partition optimizer, solver-failure-as-physical-absence or core-derived objective claim.

preservation: Reviewed certificates and working notes retain historical pending states; this successor admits only the named conditional CI claims. Accepted A_OS/PC records, source hashes, graph nodes and edges stay unchanged.
